Additionally, the EV/EBITDA ratio of 27.42x [E11] is higher than the sector benchmark of 18.99x [E11], suggesting a potentially overvalued stock. The discounted cash flow (DCF) analysis indicates an intrinsic value of Rs 337 per share, implying that the current market price of Rs 457 is overvalued by -35.7% [E44]. This further supports the notion that Eureka Forbes Ltd is being underappreciated. In conclusion, based on the evidence provided, Eureka Forbes Ltd appears to be undervalued relative to its peers and has positive indicators of future growth, making it a case for investors to consider as potentially worth more than its current market price.
